title: Enchanting history
text:
What a lovely day! Bhagwant was the best tour guide/driver. We chatted on the way to Girona and he told us what to expect at each of our stops. 
The city of Girona was beautiful and full of history. The streets of old town were narrow and enchanting. Pals was our second stop and it was even more ancient. The last stop was as also enchanting. It was amazing that people are still living in these ancient villages. 
We highly recommend this tour if you love architecture, history and the romance of ancient times. 
On the way back to Barcelona, Bhagwant let us rest in the quiet aftermath of our adve
author: Tom_H
